CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: AN OPAQUE WHITE RECTANGLE IS PAINTED OVER PRINTED FORM TEXT ON CR-65 PAGE 3, IN ALL FOUR FIXTURES, AND IT PARTIALLY ERASES THE WORD 'expired' IN AN OPTION OF THE FELONY SECTION. FOUND IN THE PIXELS: delivered page 3 loses ink its pinned source prints, at x 45.40-56.44 pt, y 632.16-637.44 pt. 224 / 267 / 292 px at 300 dpi at thresholds 160 / 200 / 240; 924 / 999 / 1037 px at 600 dpi at the same three thresholds; identical to the pixel in canonical--misdemeanor, canonical--felony, boundary--misdemeanor and boundary--felony. Every lost pixel reads grey 255 in the delivered file - a solid white fill, not antialiasing. CONFIRMED IN THE BYTES, not inferred: the delivered page-3 content stream contains '1 0 0 1 45.317 623.137 cm' followed by '/FlatWidget-5373953175 Do', and that XObject's whole body is '1 g / 0 0 11.2171 14.3578 re / f' - set fill to white, fill an 11.2171 x 14.3578 pt rectangle. Every other flattened checkbox on the page is placed at its rect's BOTTOM-left (44.4196 685.662, 44.317 647.099, 45.317 517.46, 43.7657 460.14, 45.317 358.82); this one is placed at 623.137, which is the TOP of its rect. WHY: CR-65 stores Check Box10.2's /Rect inverted, [45.317, 623.137, 56.5341, 608.779], and pdf-lib's form.flatten() reads Rect[1] as the origin, so the appearance lands 14.358 pt too high. The repository already holds the diagnosis: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/INVERTED_WIDGET_RECTANGLES.json names this exact widget, this exact rect and misplacementPoints y 14.357999999999947. WHAT IS DEFACED: pdftotext -bbox on the pinned source places the word 'expired' at x 41.64-77.51, y 632.04-642.84 - the second line of Section III's option 'the indictment has been quashed and the statute of limitations for refiling the charge or charges has / expired or the prosecuting agency confirms that the charge or charges will not be refiled.' The white box covers x 45.40-56.44 of it, so roughly the letters 'xpi', plus the descender below. This is on the face of a sworn petition the participant files, on the page that carries the felony grounds the form tells them to read before ticking one. NOT A COUNTER'S BLIND ZERO BY ACCIDENT: reports/actual-writes.json and the builder's own reader are glyph-based, and a white fill draws no glyph while pdftotext still extracts the glyphs underneath it, so the defect is invisible to every published counter and to the family's own guards. See guardMutation below, where I made the guards fail to prove they can, then made this defect class worse and watched them pass. THE CONTROL FOR THIS MEASUREMENT: on the same page, in the same render, at the same thresholds, canonical--felony adds 194 / 208 / 224 px in CR-65 Check Box10.4 at [43.7657, 460.14, 55.8801, 474.498] where canonical--misdemeanor adds 0 / 0 / 0, so this render both sees ink that is there and reports none where none is. SEPARATELY, AND NOT PART OF THIS VERDICT: added ink outside every widget rectangle is 0 px on all 11 pages of all four fixtures, so nothing this build DREW strayed; the defect is ink the flatten step ERASED.

Measured: the rendered ink in that line's box fell from 7,544 px to 0 px (300 dpi, grey <= 200, ROI x340-525 pt / y442-457 pt). assertRepairInvariants PASSED with no defect reported. pdftotext still extracts the line from the mutated bytes, which is exactly why: every guard in this family is glyph-based, and occlusion removes ink without removing glyphs.
guardMutation.conclusion: This family's guards can fail, and they cannot fail on the defect this family has. Two independent mechanisms hide it: the guards read glyphs, and the negative control's baseline is the same binary driven through the same flatten pipeline, so a defect the pipeline introduces is subtracted out by construction.

measurementMethod.render: pdftoppm -r <dpi> -gray -png, WITH annotations. -hide-annotations was used exactly once and is labelled as a control below. measurementMethod.greyThresholds: a pixel counts as ink at grey <= 200 of 255. measurementMethod.scope: per delivered page against its pinned source page, differenced directionally (added = dark in delivered and not in source; removed = the reverse), then every differing pixel attributed to a widget rectangle read first-hand from the pinned source binary with pdf-lib, or for Minnesota to the write cell the field map declares. measurementMethod.perWidgetAppearanceCount: null for all three families. Every delivered fixture here carries no AcroForm and zero widget annotations (measured with pdf-lib), so there is no widget to count an appearance on. This is null, not 0.

measurementMethod.render: pdftoppm -r <dpi> -gray -png, WITH annotations. -hide-annotations was used exactly once and is labelled as a control below. Every PNG pdftoppm emits under -gray is mode RGB with the three channels equal; this lane asserted channel equality and read channel 0, rather than assuming mode L.
measurementMethod.resolution: 300 dpi for every whole-page measurement (letter 612x792pt renders 2550x3300 px); 600 dpi for the two close reads that are named as 600 dpi.
measurementMethod.greyThresholds: a pixel counts as ink at grey <= 200 of 255. Every finding and every zero below is also published at 160 and at 240, because these packets carry light grey fills: MN delivered page 17 reads 538,987 ink px at threshold 200 and 1,652,132 at 240, so a single threshold would not have been honest.
measurementMethod.scope: per delivered page against its pinned source page, differenced directionally (added = dark in delivered and not in source; removed = the reverse), then every differing pixel attributed to a widget rectangle read first-hand from the pinned source binary with pdf-lib, or for Minnesota to the write cell the field map declares. Rects are normalised min/max before use.
measurementMethod.positiveControl: no zero below is reported without ink the same render drew in the same bytes; each family's control is named in its own row.
measurementMethod.perWidgetAppearanceCount: null for all three families. Every delivered fixture here carries no AcroForm and zero widget annotations (measured with pdf-lib), so there is no widget to count an appearance on. This is null, not 0.
measurementMethod.whatThisDidNotMeasure: a calibrated full-page visual review of layout defects the delivered file inherits unchanged from its pinned source. That is the central raster gate's scope, and each row states that family's raster standing separately.
